title: Plagiarism Panic Email
scenario: An email claims you are under investigation and must click to submit a defense.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Plagiarism Panic Email: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Academic integrity notices come through formal university systems.
